text: {"rules":[],"notes":"D014 describes Boston's Housing Stability Notification Act (effective 2020-11-06). It requires landlords to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with a Notice to Quit or non-renewal, and to send a copy to the Office of Housing Stability. It does not limit the causes for which a tenancy may be ended, and it sets no relocation assistance. It is a procedural notice-of-resources rule, not a just-cause eviction rule. It also says nothing on rent increase limits, security deposits, application or screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so there is no in-scope rule to record."}
